answer: Duplicating an identity means re-acquiring real-world entropy, and every forged clone dilutes its plume, triggering slashing of the full bond, so attack cost scales with each fake persona created. Sybil resistance here works through a staked identity anchored to a persistent beacon: each agent must burn a costly bond and continuously emit a signed plume of work receipts tied to a unique physical landmark hash, the reef coordinates and basalt strata sample from its registered node. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
